findings.evidence: `rg -n "@\[expose\].*homeomorph"` shows exposures at lines 51, 77, 94, and 115, while lines 65/70/82/87/101/107/120/126 provide `@[simp]` apply and symm_apply lemmas characterizing the forward and inverse maps.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from `homeomorphEquivOfEq`, `homeomorphEquiv`, `homeomorphMulEquivOfEq`, and `homeomorphMulEquiv`; keep or add characteristic lemmas for any needed projections instead.
findings.issue: The four new bundled definitions are marked `@[expose]`, making their construction bodies part of the public interface without a demonstrated need to unfold them.

summary: The homeomorphism-invariance API has the expected characterization lemmas, but the new bundled equivalences expose their bodies even though downstream users can use the exported apply/symm lemmas instead.
